I'm convinced because I'm the only one in this county who truly understands where farming is headed, and my family and the accountant are just too small-minded to see what a massive breakthrough I'm making.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about what makes you think you're the only one who truly understands the future of farming, and why you believe your family and accountant are too small-minded to see your vision?\n\nPatient: I've spent my whole life on this land, and I can see how the technology and the soil connect in a way they just can't comprehend. They are completely bogged down by rigid spreadsheets and outdated farming methods, while I have a vision that is lightyears ahead of everyone else. It's like I've been chosen to lead this breakthrough, and they are just too blind to see it.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about what you mean by 'chosen to lead this breakthrough', and do you feel like you have a special role or mission that sets you apart from others?\n\nPatient: I absolutely feel like I've been set apart with a special mission, because I'm the only one in this entire county who truly understands where farming is headed. It's like I've been chosen to prove everybody wrong and show them what the future looks like. When my family or the banker says my plans don't make sense, it's just because they're too small-minded to see the breakthrough I'm making.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe that your special mission or role is in any way related to a higher power, fate, or something beyond just your own abilities or intelligence?\n\nPatient: No, I wouldn't say it's about a higher power or fate at all. I feel chosen because of my own superior vision, and I'm going to use my abilities to prove everyone wrong.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me how your mood has been over the past few weeks, have you been feeling particularly happy, irritable, or has it been a mix of both?\n\nPatient: It’s definitely been a mix of both. When my family or the banker says my numbers don't add up, it's just because they are too small-minded to see the major breakthrough I'm making.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had a period in your life where you didn't feel like you were destined for greatness or had these exceptionally high-energy, racing thoughts, and if so, how long did that period last?\n\nPatient: A few months back, I had a brief spell where my energy dipped and I wasn't running around as much, but even then, I still heard that man's voice at night and knew the co-op was tracking my drones. Those calmer periods are only short stretches, though, lasting maybe a couple of weeks at most. On top of that, I know the co-op board and the seed companies are secretly tracking my drones because they want to steal my regenerative system and shut our farm down.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about what makes you think the co-op board and seed companies are tracking your drones and trying to sabotage your work, and do you have any evidence of this?\n\nPatient: I know everyone keeps telling me it’s just not possible, but I know they are secretly tracking everything I do with the drones. It relates directly to my mission because he is the one guiding me on exactly how to plant and warning me about the sabotage, confirming that I'm the only one chosen to lead this breakthrough. It makes perfect sense that I'm receiving this guidance since I'm the only one in the county who truly understands where farming is headed.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about the voice you hear at night, like what it sounds like and what kind of things it says to you, and do you ever hear it during the day as well?\n\nPatient: Yes, I hear it during the day too, especially when I'm out working in the fields, and it's a man's voice that sounds as clear as if he's standing right next to me. Even when I turn around and there's nobody there, the voice is completely real and clear.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how the voice you hear and your feelings of being chosen for a special mission relate to your mood swings, and do you think the voice influences your high-energy periods or irritability?\n\nPatient: They are completely tied together because when I'm feeling on top of the world and buzzing with energy, that voice is right there guiding my planting and confirming I'm chosen to change farming. It all happens at the exact same time, and it just proves to me that I have to keep pushing forward.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever questioned the reality of the voice you hear or the idea that you're being sabotaged, or if you've ever considered the possibility that these things might not be real?\n\nPatient: I have never doubted it for a second because everything I'm experiencing is completely real, and it is frustrating that my family and the accountant don't believe me. That man's voice in the fields is as clear as day, and the threat of the co-op and seed companies trying to sabotage my work is a concrete reality. There is absolutely no way I'm imagining any of this, and I know my plans are right.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about when you first started hearing the voice, was it sudden or did it develop over time, and have you experienced any other types of hallucinations like seeing things that aren't there?\n\nPatient: The voice started about a year ago, a couple of months after I really ramped up the regenerative project and started working those long, stressful hours. It is strictly just the man's voice that I hear.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever experienced a period where the voice stopped or significantly decreased, and if so, how did that affect your mood and your plans for the farm?\n\nPatient: That voice hasn't really stopped or gone away since it first started. When my family or the banker says my numbers don't add up, it's just because they are too small-minded to see the major breakthrough I'm making.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had a period in your life where you didn't feel like you were destined for greatness or had these exceptionally high-energy, racing thoughts, and if so, how long did that period last?\n\nPatient: A few months back, I had a brief spell where my energy dipped and I wasn't running around as much, but even then, I still heard that man's voice at night and knew the co-op was tracking my drones. Those calmer periods are only short stretches, though, lasting maybe a couple of weeks at most. For the vast majority of this past year, I've been in this revved-up, high-energy mode.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about the man's voice you hear at night and what you mean by the co-op tracking your drones, and do you really believe that's happening?\n\nPatient: I am absolutely certain it is happening, no matter what my family or anyone else says. On top of that, I know the co-op board and the seed companies are secretly tracking my drones because they want to steal my regenerative system and shut our farm down.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about what makes you think the co-op board and seed companies are tracking your drones and trying to sabotage your work, and do you have any evidence of this?\n\nPatient: I know everyone keeps telling me it’s just not possible, but I know they are secretly tracking everything I do with the drones. That man's voice in the fields is as clear as day, and the threat of the co-op and seed companies trying to sabotage my work is a concrete reality. There is absolutely no way I'm imagining any of this, and I know my plans are right.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about when you first started hearing the voice, was it sudden or did it develop over time, and have you experienced any other types of hallucinations like seeing things that aren't there?\n\nPatient: The voice started about a year ago, a couple of months after I really ramped up the regenerative project and started working those long, stressful hours. It is strictly just the man's voice that I hear.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever experienced a period where the voice stopped or significantly decreased, and if so, how did that affect your mood and your plans for the farm?\n\nPatient: That voice hasn't really stopped or gone away since it first started. Even during that spell a few months ago when my energy dipped and I wasn't tearing around the farm as much, I still heard the man's voice at night and stayed convinced they were tracking my drones. That voice is directly tied to my mission, though, because he is the one guiding my planting and warning me about the sabotage, which just proves I've been chosen to show everyone where farming is headed. It makes perfect sense that I'm getting this guidance to help me prove everyone wrong and make this breakthrough.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voice you hear could be a part of your own mind, rather than an external voice, and have you considered that your feelings of being sabotaged might not be based on real events?\n\nPatient: Absolutely not, that voice is as real as yours is, sounding like a man standing right next to me in the field.
